Name: Ancichoke (Ancient Artichoke)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=5]Why artichoke？[/size]
[color=#00ff00][size=6][center]A.  Because I like it.[/center][/size][/color]
It's no secret that by the midpoint of the game, the place is filled with ancient fruit...
However, I have long thought that it would be very troublesome to harvest large quantities.
So they decided to create a crop that could replace the ancient fruit that could be harvested with a sickle at the expense of a little work and a little profit.

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Specific features of the...[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]The seed specifications are exactly the same as those of the ancient fruit.[/size]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=5]Harvesting can be done with a scythe, so you can plant a whole bunch![/size][/color]
[*][size=4]The profit margin is set at 90% of the ancient fruit.[/size]
[*][size=4]To obtain Ancichoke Seeds , a special seed maker is required, and three ancient fruits can produce one Ancichoke Seed.[/size]
[*][size=4]Although the type is "vegetable," the concept is to replace ancient fruit, so when placed in barrels, juice wine is produced.[/size]
[*][size=4]This juice wine can be put in a cask to improve its quality just like regular wine.[/size]
[/list]
[color=#cc4125][size=5]v1.2~[/size][/color]
Dedicated barrels have been added that can process 5 and 10 Ancichoke each at a time.

[color=#f4cccc][size=5]"Ancichoke Seed Maker"  and "Ancichoke Keg" liberation conditions
[/size][/color][spoiler]
[color=#00ff00]Ancichoke Seed Maker[/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]It is after the second year.[/size]
[*][size=4]"Farming" level is 9 or higher. (Normal seed maker release level)[/size]
[*][size=4]Shipped more than 10 pieces of Ancient Fruit.[/size]
[*][size=4]I am finding "Ancient Seed (Artifacts)".[/size]
[*][size=4]More than 60 items have been donated to the Museum. [/size]
[/list]             (The number of donated items that reach the condition for Rusty Key's event to occur.)
If you have completed all of the above, you will receive a recipe mail.

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Ancichoke Keg[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]I remember the recipe for "Ancichoke Seed Maker",[/size]
[*][size=4]"Farming" level is 10.[/size]
[*][size=4]"Ancichoke Juice Wine" has shipped more than 10 bottles.[/size]
[/list]If you have completed all of the above, you will receive a recipe mail.

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Ancichoke Keg (SP)[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=4]I remember the recipe for "Ancichoke Keg",[/size]
[*][size=4]"Ancichoke Juice Wine" has shipped more than 20 bottles.[/size]
[/list]If you have completed all of the above, you will receive a recipe mail.

[/spoiler]

[size=4]Japanese is currently supported in addition to the default English.[/size]
